restaurant_name: ดวงใจทันตแพทย์
text:
I had a filling three months ago. The filling was very large.
The filling fell out and wasn't durable. I couldn't chew anything hard.
Plus, when I called to get it fixed, I had to wait until the dentist who did the filling was available on Saturday (I called on Monday).
Are you crazy? Who can wait?
In the end, I had to get it fixed somewhere else. I'm giving up on this place forever. It's terrible.
